summary: Lower JavaScript truthiness checks through a compatibility helper when the static type is not already boolean.

target.notes: The helper must implement JavaScript ToBoolean semantics for all supported runtime values. A direct C# condition is valid only when type analysis proves the expression is boolean.

semantics.truthy_note: Objects, including empty arrays and empty objects, are truthy in JavaScript.

caveats: BigInt zero is also falsy and must be handled when BigInt support is enabled.
The exact internal representation of undefined and boxed/dynamic values affects the helper implementation.
